blocks.text: This 11.11, maybe the thing worth adding to cart is something for yourself. Kenny Rogers Roasters is bringing back Solo Love Club for its third year this National Singles’ Day, and for the first time ever, the celebration comes with its own merch. From November 11 to 30, 2026, Solo Love Club returns with “Be You, Do You, For You,” a celebration of doing things on your own terms, whether that means taking yourself out for lunch, spending a quiet day alone, celebrating a personal win, or simply choosing yourself without needing a reason.
